howToPlay: Use Najia to control areas by stacking poison damage on enemies with her piercing jars. Utilize her long range to keep enemies at a distance while managing her poison stacks to maximize damage over time.
gears: Equip DAMAGE to increase her output when low on health and SPEED to take advantage of her mobility across bushes.
trait: Najia suits players who enjoy tactical zone control and wearing down opponents with stacking damage effects.
